title: Elixir of Universal Resistance
summary: Gain resistance to all damage for 10 rounds.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain resistance to all damage for 10 rounds.
fields.Crafting: Combine Vitriol of Divine Miasma with any Sublimate.
fields.Stacking: Behaves as a potion and can coexist with normal elixirs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
